responsibility: Implements the core C++ side of the Moxie GCC target backend: target hook registrations in targetm, calling convention decisions, return-value handling, argument passing and varargs behavior, per-function frame data, prologue/epilogue expansion, trampoline/static-chain support for nested functions, operand and address printing for assembly output, and legitimacy tests for Moxie addressing modes. It consumes GCC RTL/tree target interfaces and produces target-specific decisions and emitted RTL/assembly support that complement the declarative instruction patterns in moxie.md.
same_name_distinction: Contains the imperative C++ implementation of the Moxie backend hooks and helper routines that use the static target definitions from moxie.h, drive behavior referenced by patterns in moxie.md, and consume option flags defined in moxie.opt; unlike the others, this is the executable hook logic rather than declarative target description, RTL patterns, or option metadata.
